title: Fix gamma_flip/max_pain artifacts + stale-IV hygiene in GexDashboard.py (issue #1)
scope:
Fix repo issue #1. Bug evidence (TSM packet 2026-10-15, spot 422.05, total net GEX -52.6M): market_snapshot.nearest_gamma_flip=430 (correct — aggregated strike data crosses sign at 430) but per-expiry gamma_flip values are 370/230/250/310 (artifacts), and several max_pain values are 225-235 (far from tradable range). Deep-wing strikes carry stale impliedVolatility of 300-450%.

ROOT CAUSES:
- compute_gamma_flip(df) scans strikes ascending and returns the FIRST negative->positive gex crossing. Deep-OTM strikes have noise-level gex (~1e-12) from stale quotes, so the 'flip' lands on a meaningless strike.
- compute_max_pain(df) evaluates ALL strikes unbounded — massive far-OTM put OI (e.g. 10,640 @ 270) drags the result far below spot.
- Stale wing IVs pass into the ai_packet strikes unflagged.

REQUIRED CHANGES (GexDashboard.py):
1. compute_gamma_flip: add optional `spot` param (keep signature backward-compatible: compute_gamma_flip(df, spot=None)). Ignore strikes whose |gex| is below a materiality threshold (suggest: < 1% of max |gex| in that df). Among remaining sign crossings, return the crossing NEAREST TO SPOT when spot is provided; if spot is None, keep the ascending-scan behavior but still apply the materiality filter. If no material crossing exists, return None (honest) — never return an artifact strike. Update call sites (compute_gamma_flip(df) and compute_gamma_flip(sub) in build_ai_packet) to pass spot.
2. compute_max_pain: add optional `spot` param the same way. When spot is provided, restrict candidate strikes to [0.7*spot, 1.3*spot]; if that filter empties the candidate set, fall back to all strikes. Update call sites to pass spot.
3. In build_ai_packet strike_objects: strikes with implied_volatility > 2.0 (200%, stale quote) must keep OI/GEX fields but get implied_volatility replaced by None and a 'stale_iv': true flag added; normal strikes keep their value. Document the flag in the packet (e.g. a data_quality note in meta or instructions).
4. tests/test_gex_metrics.py (new): must run OFFLINE — no yfinance/network imports. Reconstruct per-expiry DataFrames from tests/fixtures/TSM_ai_packet.json (each strike entry -> a row; for compute_gamma_flip a df with columns strike+gex suffices since gex is precomputed per strike; for compute_max_pain reconstruct call/put rows from call_oi/put_oi). REQUIRED assertions: (a) expiry 2026-10-16 flip in [425.0, 435.0]; (b) expiries with no material sign crossing return None (not an artifact strike); (c) every expiry max_pain within [0.7*422.05, 1.3*422.05]; (d) aggregated whole-book flip in [425.0, 435.0]; (e) synthetic edge cases: empty df -> None, all-negative -> None, all-positive -> None; (f) stale IV flagging on a synthetic strike with iv=3.5.
5. NO yfinance, network, or full-script runs anywhere in implementation or tests — market is closed and live fetches return bad data.
6. Keep code style consistent with the file (verbose spaced style is fine; do not reformat unrelated code). Do NOT touch VolumeProfileVisualizer.py, docs/, .github/, README.md.
